methodology.scope: Local SQL/worker contention and physical PostgreSQL standby; not production qualification or cluster-wide enforcement.
methodology.pool_signal: 100ms sampling, InUse/MaxOpen >= .75 limits background resource to1 (critical reservation1); external consumers hold3/4 connections
methodology.replication: Physical streaming standby; real replay pause creates >64KiB WAL backlog, actual stop creates unknown; 1s heartbeat, max reply age3s, sample100ms, cache maxAge1s, collector timeout80ms
methodology.measurement: Independent arrivals; 3s clients, database work context1s, no retries. Four phases 1/3/3/1s. p95 on successful requests shown with rejection and timeout rates.
